parsed.explanation: Combined regime pairs state-level most-protective protections—public-accommodations, housing, employment and hate-crime coverage, X markers, shield and mandated care coverage—with operative federal universal exposures: binary passport policy, entry refusal/fraud screening, federal single-sex facility exclusion, and documented immigration/corrections custody abuse. State protections do not cancel federal entry, facilities or custody. No routine imprisonment for presentation or execution is documented, but detention consequences are severe and remedies are slow or unresolved.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal binary sex definition; X passports not newly issued, existing X valid to expiry; 2025 cable requires refusal on document discrepancy/doubt and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility, never automatic.
entry_documents.protection: State X on licences/birth certificates by request without medical documentation; state anti-discrimination laws since 2005-2011.
entry_documents.interaction: Visitor uses home passport; state marker rules do not override federal passport/entry screening or a fraud referral into detention.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody reports: forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse of trans men. From 2026 corrections model: hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric substitution; prisoner counts stopped.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Hate-crime statute covers gender identity; no documented visitor-specific custodial remedy or inspection regime in dossier.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry discrepancy can escalate to investigation/detention, then federal custody placement and care withdrawal; state protections do not govern federal custody.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal order bars government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity; 4 states criminalise certain bathroom use after refusal to depart, with a documented arrest and 24h men's-ward hold elsewhere.
federal_state_facilities.protection: This state is not listed among 10 barring trans people in schools/government buildings; public-accommodations discrimination barred since 2006.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: State access protections coexist with, but do not pre-empt, federal-building exclusion; private/state venues are more protected than federal facilities.

care_services.exposure: Federal orders target minors' gender care, propose barring public insurance under 18, and custody removes hormone medication; several orders blocked/enjoined, status contested.
care_services.protection: State healthcare shield (27 Sept 2026) protects patients/providers for care lawful here but banned at home; insurance discrimination barred since 2016, reassignment coverage mandated 2023.
care_services.interaction: Shield helps adult/minor care in state settings, but invocation/documentation is not documented and cannot override federal custody, entry or funding rules.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive orders define sex binary, remove gender-identity materials/policies; counterterrorism strategy prioritises 'radically pro-transgender' groups; teacher social-transition prosecution directed.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: 2020 national employment ruling prohibits gender-identity employment discrimination; state hate-crime law covers gender identity/expression; panic defences abolished 2019.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hostile federal framing raises outing/investigation probability, while state/national anti-discrimination and hate-crime law provide partial recourse where actors comply.

minors_guardians.exposure: Federal minors-care order, funding threats and prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition including names/pronouns; 27 states ban youth care nationally.
minors_guardians.protection: State shield law, conversion-therapy ban on minors since 2018, education-equity and anti-bullying protections covering gender identity/expression.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling guardian/minor may obtain state care, but federal school/funding/custody exposure and undocumented shield invocation leave uncertainty.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No state-specific anti-trans violence, hate-crime prosecution or police-response figures documented; 2025 poll found 66% support assigned-sex document listing.
street_violence_police_response.protection: State and national hate-crime coverage for gender identity; housing/public-accommodations/employment anti-discrimination laws; state commission created 2022.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Paper protections exist, but dossier does not show enforcement intensity; federal hostility may discourage reporting despite state recourse.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit unresolved; travellers reported passports confiscated/blocked and stranded; several federal orders enjoined but others operative, making timing decisive.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Civil-liberties suit, court injunctions, legal-aid FAQ, state commission and health-insurance mandates; appeals exist but are slow.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies may succeed eventually yet rarely prevent entry refusal, facility exclusion or short-stay delay; state remedies do not bind federal actors.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: discretionary extended screening/document discrepancy can cause refusal and costly delay, remedies slow; here fraud-ineligibility consideration and federal facilities add severity, but state protections and court injunctions keep it from lower tiers.

Lower: both have equality protections and brief/document friction with remedies, but here federal entry, federal facilities and documented custody abuse are operative and state law cannot override them, unlike the anchor's national protection prevailing.

Higher: no routine police identity stops, confiscations, district bans or fines for trans visitors documented, and no systematic detention without charge; harms are primarily federal administrative exclusion and conditional custody risk rather than routine street enforcement.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller mainly encounters a split regime. In state venues, housing, employment, insurance and care, documented protections are unusually strong and may work. At the border, in federal facilities and if detained, federal binary-document rules, refusal/fraud screening and facility exclusion apply universally, with custody abuse documented at high severity. That interaction—protective state law unable to cancel federal entry/facility/custody exposure—places the case near the 0.55 anchors: administrative exclusion and conditional severe detention, without routine imprisonment or lethal targeting.
